application_gate.behavior: Artifact approval, concept promotion, and content recall fail closed unless the Defender Blob tag is No threats found.
application_gate.reason_not_deployed: Deploying the gate before the Azure scanner is active would lock existing and new source artifacts.

next_actions: Grant the production operator Security Admin at subscription scope or perform the Defender enablement with an identity that has Microsoft.Security/datascanners/write.
Re-run the Defender setting and verify operationStatus=Succeeded and onUpload.isEnabled=true.
Run a benign on-upload scan and a filtered on-demand baseline scan for source-artifacts.
Merge and deploy the fail-closed application gate only after both scan checks pass.
boundary: Public-safe posture evidence; no credentials, blob names, user content, or private knowledge are included.
